title: move(drag=...) drags a creature the mover isn't grappling

history.reason: This fix also makes tests/srd/test_glossary.py::test_cant_drag_a_creature_someone_else_grapples (T-3) pass, and it now fails as a strict XPASS. Please remove its xfail marker too and close T-3 as fixed by this change, since the rule is the same: only the grappler can drag.
